back.en: Matter is made of tiny particles that are always moving; heating increases their kinetic energy
back.bm: Jirim terdiri daripada zarah halus yang sentiasa bergerak; pemanasan menambah tenaga kinetiknya

back.en: Solid: closely packed, vibrate. Liquid: close, move past each other. Gas: far apart, move fast randomly
back.bm: Pepejal: rapat, bergetar. Cecair: rapat, bergerak melepasi satu sama lain. Gas: berjauhan, bergerak laju secara rawak

back.en: Constant temperature at which a solid turns into a liquid
back.bm: Suhu malar ketika pepejal bertukar menjadi cecair

back.en: Tiny, dense, positively charged nucleus (gold foil experiment)
back.bm: Nukleus kecil, tumpat dan bercas positif (eksperimen kerajang emas)

back.en: Electrons move around the nucleus in fixed shells
back.bm: Elektron bergerak mengelilingi nukleus dalam petala tetap

back.en: Thomson discovered the electron; Chadwick discovered the neutron
back.bm: Thomson menemui elektron; Chadwick menemui neutron

back.en: Z = protons; A = protons + neutrons; neutrons = A − Z
back.bm: Z = proton; A = proton + neutron; neutron = A − Z

back.en: ᴬ_Z X — nucleon number top, proton number bottom
back.bm: ᴬ_Z X — nombor nukleon di atas, nombor proton di bawah

back.en: Electrons in the outermost shell — they decide chemical properties
back.bm: Elektron di petala paling luar — menentukan sifat kimia

back.en: Same proton number, different neutron number; same chemical properties
back.bm: Nombor proton sama, bilangan neutron berbeza; sifat kimia sama

back.en: C-14 dating, Co-60 radiotherapy, I-131 thyroid, Na-24 pipe leaks, P-32 plant studies, U-235 nuclear fuel
back.bm: C-14 penentuan usia, Co-60 radioterapi, I-131 tiroid, Na-24 kebocoran paip, P-32 kajian tumbuhan, U-235 bahan api nuklear

back.en: Particles spread from a region of high concentration to low concentration; fastest in gases
back.bm: Zarah meresap dari kawasan berkepekatan tinggi ke rendah; paling cepat dalam gas

example.en: Perfume smell spreads across a room; purple KMnO₄ spreads through water.
example.bm: Bau minyak wangi tersebar di bilik; KMnO₄ ungu meresap dalam air.

front.en: Flat part of a heating curve

back.en: Temperature stays constant during melting or boiling: heat is absorbed to overcome the forces between particles
back.bm: Suhu tetap semasa melebur atau mendidih: haba diserap untuk mengatasi daya tarikan antara zarah

tip.en: Fill shells 2, 8, 8 … for the first 20 elements.
